title: Nine Years' War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Nine Years' War", at revision 1378306590, opens: "The Nine Years' War was a European great power conflict from 1688 to 1697 between France and the Grand Alliance. Fought primarily in Europe, related conflicts include the Williamite war in Ireland, and King William's War in North America." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q152218, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "war principally fought in Central Europe from 1688 to 1697". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
